standaloneClusters.label:
OPTIONAL PAID CAPABILITIES + DECISION GATE | All network options proposed, no deployment
Isolated Fargate/ECR: verify ecr.api + ecr.dkr interface endpoints, S3 layer path and Logs; add regional STS / KMS / other APIs only if used. SageMaker network-isolation/service-side paths need their own matrix. Interface endpoints add service × AZ × hours + GB costs.
NAT adds gateway-hours + GB + applicable IPv4/transfer, even when mostly idle. Gateway S3/DynamoDB endpoints add no endpoint fee, but do not reach arbitrary internet. No VPC/account/Region/CIDR or A/B training choice is approved.
IAM / endpoint / bucket policies must preserve CloudFront OAC, unattached roles, CI and recovery. No blanket SourceVpce deny. SGs are not DNS/domain filters; API Gateway invocation is not inbound traffic to a Lambda ENI. Private API/VPN is not baseline.
£100 all-in cash = £70 operation + £30 reserve. Network fixed charges can threaten that envelope. Compare measured N0 versus justified N1; obtain owner choice before infrastructure work. Native shapes show planned topology, not live resources.
Sources: official AWS Lambda, VPC/PrivateLink, CloudFront, ECS and SageMaker docs • MP network-topology-options.md • DEC-001–041. Existing pages 1–4 preserved. Current code remains health / volatile SSE / static preview; synthetic local/dev only.
